purpose: Unchanged full repository validation requires existing ignored historical audio evidence. A temporary directory symlink provides read access to the original workspace files; existing validators authenticate their exact hashes. No old evidence was changed or newly transcribed.
cleanup: Remove only the temporary symlink after validation.
additionalPurpose: Existing v2.4, v2.5 and v3.8 source validators require local historic transcripts. Each newly supplied source remains authenticated by unchanged repository checks. The unchanged multi-speaker historical manifest also needs its 16 original source directories.
limitation: A broad initial link set caused the optional corpus-local hash scan to wait on unrelated cloud-backed archived files. That run was stopped and preserved. The final setup provides only inputs required by the unchanged v2.4, v2.5 and v3.8 historical checks; durable corpus records are all still validated.
